annotations.title: Top-100 FHA lenders by denial rate

description: ANSWERS: "which FHA lender denies the most or the fewest", "rank FHA lenders by denial rate", "which lenders are covered", "how wide is the spread". Returns the ranked list of the 100 largest FHA lenders with name, slug, rate and volume; the 2025 span runs 1.8 to 78.7 percent inside the same federal program. NOT FOR: lenders outside the top 100, or any recommendation about where to apply. Historical observation computed from the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2). Not a prediction about any individual application. Attribution: FinanceRateCalc, CC BY 4.0.
